tasks.title: Preserve user focus during passive hierarchy source restoration
tasks.body:
Goal:
Prevent passive hierarchy source restoration from stealing established user focus.

Current behavior:
The saved native trace places focus on Skip to main content, then Tasks and subtasks about300milliseconds later. TodoHierarchyPanel.Changed calls ClearDraft on a selected-source transition; ClearDraft unconditionally schedules heading focus. Source restoration therefore reuses a focus request intended for explicit user actions.

Touch:
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/Components/TodoHierarchyPanel.razor`
- `tests/Habitica.WebApp.Tests/Workspace/TodoHierarchyPanelTests.cs`
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/State/TodoWorkspacePresentation.cs`

Implementation constraints:
Keep source-private draft/selection resets, original receipt boundaries, branch navigation, edit and review focus. Separate passive source reset from explicit action focus without delays, retries, global focus suppression, CSS changes or weaker keyboard assertions. Existing canonical focus behavior remains the specification; this repairs unintended source-restoration behavior. Record research, Red/Green, source fingerprints and actual rendered evidence in history. No new feature or revised UX specification is introduced.

Validation:
Use focused runnable Red before the scoped repair. Revalidate the existing immutable native shell and hierarchy contracts at repaired sources, and inspect current light/dark phone/desktop screenshots. Other completed checks are reused only when actual source/definition/environment/evidence remain current.
